title: Solo | TRAE - Collaborate with Intelligence
html:
SOLO: The Responsive Coding Agent

Go full speed with instant control. SOLO responds to your ideas, adapts to your context, and keeps up with your workflow. All in one visual workspace. Unlock the next great thing with SOLO.

From a plugin to an AI engineer

AI used to be a feature in your tools. Now your tools are features for AI. SOLO orchestrates browsers, terminals, editors and essential tools to work with your codebase—all while keeping you visually in the loop. SOLO is built for the future of development.

Plugin

AI enters the workflow along with the first line of code

First came the TRAE Plugin — bringing the AI copilot into everyday developer tools.

IDE

AI was no longer confined to the sidebar — it now has its own native space.

TRAE IDE was specifically built for AI-first coding, unlocking deep contextual understanding, conversational interaction, and multi-agent collaboration.

All your context and tools, in one place

SOLO works across your entire development stack in real-time. It plans, executes, and delivers in a flow, enabling you to bring ideas from concept to shipped reality.

SOLO is All You Need

Real software. Shipped faster.

From idea to a product
SOLO Builder moves fast - turning ideas into live products with end-to-end execution. SOLO Coder goes deep-planning carefully, executing precisely, and coordinating sub agents for specialized tasks. These agents work as a flexible team. Choose the right combination for each challenge.
Plan, collaborate and review with SOLO
Start by thinking out loud. SOLO breaks down your ideas into structured formats- docs, TODO lists, and plans - so you're perfectly aligned before any code is written. The extended view gives you full visibility into your agent's work. Jump in and review at any time. Always know what it's doing, why it's doing it, and what comes next.
Adapts to your context in real-time
SOLO brings scattered context into unified intelligence. Terminal, editor, documentation, browser, integrations, and Figma—everything you need, all in one place. The agent intelligently selects the right context and tools for each task, while responding instantly to every action you take. All your actions can be responded in real-time. Your exploration and AI execution flow together in a continuous feedback loop.
Ship in parallel
Run multiple agents on different tasks at once, each with its own model and context. Choose the best model for each task. Switch focus freely while agents keep working independently.See every task's progress in real-time.
"Speak" Your Requirements
TRAE SOLO supports voice input, allowing you to interact with TRAE just as you would with a teammate. AI output is no longer limited to code—the expandable dynamic view on the right provides visual and intuitive feedback.
Build with SOLO: Talk. Think. Ship.

TRAE SOLO GA Release.

TRAE SOLO is the responsive coding agent we built for real-world software development.

Amber ShenNovember 4, 2025
